sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: This policy explains what information is processed when you use {{app}}, why, and who it is shared with.

sections.title: No account
sections.body: {{app}} never asks you to sign up, give an email address or set a password. On first launch the app creates a random, anonymous player ID that contains no information about you.

sections.title: Data stored on your device
sections.body: Your progress (levels, stars, best scores), coins and boosters, icon packs, settings and nickname are stored on your device. A copy of your progress, coins, boosters and packs is also saved on our servers (see below).

sections.title: Data sent to our servers
sections.body: For the global leaderboard: your anonymous player ID, the nickname you choose, your scores and the moves of your ranked games. The moves are used only to check that a score is genuine. Nickname reports you send are also stored. For the game save: a copy of your progress (levels, stars, best scores), coins, boosters and icon packs, tied to your player ID, so you get it back after reinstalling or on a new phone.

sections.title: Advertising
sections.body: The game is free and shows ads through Google AdMob: videos you choose to watch in exchange for a reward (continuing a game, doubling your coins, a hint, the daily reward), and ads between some games. On iOS we ask for your permission through App Tracking Transparency before using your device's advertising identifier; if you decline, ads still appear, just not personalized. In the European Economic Area and the UK, your consent is collected through Google's form and can be changed any time in Settings → Ad privacy. You can also change your tracking choice in iPhone Settings → Privacy → Tracking.

sections.title: In-app purchases
sections.body: Purchases (coins, packs, Pairs+) are processed by Apple's App Store or Google Play. We never receive your payment details. Our provider RevenueCat receives purchase receipts to verify and restore your purchases.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.body: We measure how the app is used (screens visited, games played, purchases and ads seen) with PostHog, linked to your anonymous ID, to improve the game. This data is never sold or used for advertising. In the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom it stays off until you turn it on; anywhere, you can turn it on or off at any time in Settings → Usage statistics.

sections.title: What we don't collect
sections.body: We don't collect your name, email address, precise location, contacts or photos.

sections.title: Data sharing
sections.body: We never sell or rent any data. It is shared only with the providers the service needs: our hosting ({{host}}), Google AdMob for advertising, RevenueCat and the App Store / Google Play for purchases, and PostHog for analytics. Your nickname and scores are visible to other players on the leaderboard; your player ID never is.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Leaderboard data and the game save are kept for as long as your player ID exists, and deleted as soon as you erase your data from the app or ask us to.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you can access, correct or delete your data at any time. You can delete everything directly in the app (Settings → Privacy → Delete my data), or write to us at {{email}}.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: {{app}} is not intended for children under 13. Nicknames are filtered automatically and can be reported. If you are under 15, ask a parent before taking part in the leaderboard or making a purchase.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Traffic with our servers is encrypted (HTTPS). We apply technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration or destruction.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about this policy, write to us at {{email}}.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By downloading and using {{app}}, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

sections.title: 2. Description of the service
sections.body: {{app}} is a free memory game for entertainment only: a level-based Career mode, an Endless mode, a Daily Challenge and a global leaderboard. The app shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases. No real-money gambling is offered.

sections.title: 3. Virtual currency and items
sections.body: Coins, boosters, icon packs and other in-game items are earned by playing or bought in-app. They have no real-world value and cannot be refunded for money, exchanged or transferred outside the app. Coins and boosters are stored on your device, with a copy on our servers that brings them back after reinstalling the app. They can't be recovered after deleting your data from the app, unlike non-consumable purchases (Pairs+, packs), which can be recovered with "Restore purchases".

sections.title: 4. Pairs+
sections.body: Pairs+ is a one-time purchase, at the price shown in the app before purchase, charged to your App Store or Google Play account at confirmation. It is not a subscription: nothing renews or is charged afterwards. It removes ads between games, unlocks the Faces pack and shows a crown next to your name on the leaderboards. It can be recovered with "Restore purchases".

sections.title: 5. Refunds
sections.body: Purchases are processed by the store you downloaded the app from. Digital items are delivered immediately, so sales are final unless applicable law says otherwise. Refund requests must be made directly to Apple or Google under their own policies.

sections.title: 6. Leaderboard and nicknames
sections.body: To appear on the leaderboard you choose a nickname. It must not be abusive, discriminatory or sexual, and must not impersonate a person, a brand or the game's team. We may rename or remove any nickname that breaks these rules, including after a report. Scores are verified; a score obtained by cheating or tampering with the app may be removed without notice.

sections.title: 7. User conduct
sections.body: You agree not to hack, cheat or exploit flaws in the game, not to use the app for unlawful purposes, and not to harass other players, including through your nickname.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property
sections.body: The app's content, design, source code and trademarks remain the exclusive property of {{publisher}}. Any unauthorized reproduction or distribution is prohibited.

sections.title: 9. Disclaimer
sections.body: The app is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. We don't guarantee uninterrupted operation or constant availability of the leaderboard.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of liability
sections.body: {{publisher}} shall not be liable for any damage, direct or indirect, arising from the use of or inability to use the app, including loss of progress.

sections.title: 11. Changes
sections.body: We may change these Terms at any time. Significant changes will be announced in the app.

sections.title: 12. Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Paris, France.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these Terms, write to us at {{email}}.

sections.title: Need help?
sections.body: A bug, a question, or an inappropriate nickname on the leaderboard? Write to us at {{email}} and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

sections.title: Report a player
sections.body: Tap a nickname on the leaderboard to report or hide it, or write to us at {{email}} with the nickname in question. Reports are reviewed and nicknames that break the rules are renamed.

sections.title: Purchases
sections.body: A purchase is missing? Use "Restore purchases" in Settings or in the Shop. For a refund, contact App Store or Google Play support directly (see our Terms of Service).

sections.title: Your data
sections.body: You can change your nickname or permanently delete all your data from Settings → Privacy in the app.

sections.title: Goal
sections.body: All cards start face down. Flip them two at a time to find matching pairs of emojis. A found pair stays face up; otherwise both cards flip back.

sections.title: Moves and time
sections.body: Every two cards you flip count as one move. The fewer moves and the faster you are, the better. The clock starts on your first flip.

sections.title: Career
sections.body: Levels get harder and harder: more cards, emojis that look alike, and less time to see a missed pair. Each level you clear unlocks the next one and earns 1 to 3 stars depending on your moves and time. Two boosters can help: Peek (every card shown for a moment, before your first move) and Hint (briefly shows where the partner of a card you've already turned is, then it's up to you).

sections.title: Endless
sections.body: Boards follow one another without end and keep getting harder. You have 5 lives. You lose one on a memory slip: missing a pair when the right card had already been revealed. A blind guess on cards you've never seen costs nothing. Once per game you can keep going with one more life. No boosters are allowed, so the leaderboard stays fair.

sections.title: Daily Challenge
sections.body: The same game for everyone, every day, with Endless rules. One attempt only: it counts for the daily leaderboard.

sections.title: Score
sections.body: Each pair is worth 100 points, multiplied by your streak of pairs found in a row (up to ×5). Clearing a board earns a bonus, plus a speed bonus if you clear it fast.

sections.title: Coins
sections.body: You earn coins by clearing levels, finishing games, the Daily Challenge, and from the daily reward, whose rewards grow if you come back every day. Spend them on boosters and icon packs.
